resources.string: IR blaster ready — point phone at your TV
No IR blaster on this phone
Aim the top/back IR LED at the TV when pressing buttons
Need a phone with built-in IR (infrared) to control a TV
USB-C IR adapters are not supported
Select Haier (or Haier Alt if Power does not work). This app sends real IR signals through your phone\'s IR blaster — it cannot control a TV without IR hardware.

Your phone does not have a built-in infrared emitter, so it cannot send IR signals to a TV.

Use a phone that includes an IR blaster (common on many Xiaomi, Huawei, Redmi, Honor, and some Samsung models), then reinstall this APK.

Simulation mode has been removed — buttons only work with real IR hardware.
Swipe on the pad to move the TV cursor with real IR. Tap for OK. Works with a Bluetooth mouse too.

Wi‑Fi (Android TV, Samsung, LG, Roku) and Bluetooth type straight into the focused TV text box. With IR or Haier SmartCenter: open the TV keyboard, tap Reset cursor, and each key is typed with arrow moves + OK.

Phone and TV on the same Wi‑Fi. Works with Android TV / Google TV (Haier, TCL, Sony, Philips, Xiaomi…), Samsung, LG webOS, Roku and Haier SmartCenter. Scan or type the TV IP, then Connect — accept the prompt or enter the code shown on the TV the first time.
Enter the code shown on the TV
%1$s is showing a 6‑character code. Type it here to pair this phone (only needed once).

Phone becomes a Bluetooth keyboard + mouse + media remote (Android 9+). On the TV open Settings → Remotes & Accessories / Bluetooth → Add device, tap \"Make visible\" here, then pick this phone. Already paired? Tap the TV below.
No paired devices yet — pair from the TV first.
Bluetooth remote needs Android 9 or newer with Bluetooth.
Allow the Nearby devices permission to use the Bluetooth remote
Connect to your TV over Bluetooth first
Bluetooth mode — keyboard, mouse and media keys
No TV found on this network. Make sure the TV is on, then enter the IP from the TV\'s Network settings.
Found %1$d device(s). Tap one to connect.
Tap Scan first, or type the TV IP address
Connect to your TV over Wi‑Fi first
Wi‑Fi mode — no IR blaster required
